brief: The canvas displays an interconnected field of softly glowing, semi-transparent geometric shapes that fill the viewing area. When the user clicks or drags the cursor across the canvas, the input triggers a localized burst of vibrant, contrasting color at the cursor's position. This burst expands quickly, generating visible ripples of light that momentarily change the hue and complexity of surrounding shapes. The colors and shapes then propagate outward from the initial burst before slowly decaying and settling back into the ambient, muted glow of the background field.

statement: This sketch creates an immersive field of softly glowing geometric shapes that subtly animate in three-dimensional space. The scene features a dynamic interplay between ambient, muted glows and vibrant bursts of color that respond to user interaction. When users click or drag across the canvas, localized ripples emanate from the cursor position, temporarily altering the hue and complexity of surrounding shapes before fading back into the background field. The visual effect achieves a sense of organic flow and responsiveness through carefully controlled particle systems and geometric transformations, creating an engaging yet meditative experience where the viewer's actions directly influence the evolving visual landscape.
